newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Berlusconi to meet Kohl in Bonn on March 6.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Berlusconi to meet Kohl in Bonn on March 6.

text.p: Italy's centre-right opposition leader Silvio Berlusconi will meet German Chancellor Helmut Kohl in Bonn on March 6, Berlusconi's office said on Thursday.

A spokesman said the visit was part of "a tour Berlusconi, as leader of the opposition, is carrying out in the main European capitals...to discuss the situation in Italy and the prospects for economic and monetary union."
Three weeks ago, the former Italian prime minister met Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar.
